resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: state resume liveness folds into handoff

title: Report existing run directories as live in state resume
body:
Outcome: `krn state resume --root .` reports a capsule cleanup entry as live when its directory exists; an observer creates the directory and asserts it is not listed as missing.
Evidence: on 2026-11-02 `bin/krn state resume --root .` printed "cleanup: listed 3 / live 2; missing .krn/runs/program-audit" while `ls -d .krn/runs/program-audit` showed the directory with four files.
